messages:
deploy-bot: Starting staged rollout: embeddings-service v3.2.1 -> canary (eu-west-1). Running post-deploy smoke checks (embed-synth + p95/5xx). Ping if anything unusual.

lee: seeing elevated embed-synth 429s in eu-west-1 canary, started right after wave 1. Rate limiter? 12/50 probes returned 429. p95 from 80ms -> 380ms.

pat: can you dump the probe response headers (x-ratelimit-*, x-backoff)?

lee: pasted sample header:```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Retry-After: 5
X-RateLimit-Limit: 120
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-Embed-Variant: quant-8b
```

eng-sre: interesting — X-Embed-Variant shows `quant-8b`. v3.2.1 should have shipped `quant-4b` by default in canary. Suspect mismatch between config and modelvariant routing -> a slower variant consumed capacity and tripped adaptive backoff.

pat: ^ that would explain it. Other regions still on v3.1.8 and showing normal embed latencies.

release-manager: recommendation: pin eu-west-1 to 3.1.8 while we investigate config sync. Prefer pin over rollback so we don't disturb global rollout schedule.

lee: agree. I'll apply a regional routing override now.

deploy-bot: Action logged: routing.pin applied -> region=eu-west-1, target_version=3.1.8, actor=lee (3311223351). Canary wave paused for eu-west-1.

ci-bot: smoke-suite re-run: embed-synth checks in eu-west-1 -> 50/50 OK, p95 back to 92ms, 5xx=0, 429=0.

pat: routing pin confirmed. Opening ENG-9502 to track config/variant drift and a follow-up to validate variant-selection logic in the rollout controller. Assigning to @pat and @lee.

eng-sre: short-term mitigation ideas: 1) add a preflight that validates `X-Embed-Variant` header matches expected canary variant before switching routing; 2) increase circuit-breaker threshold for embed endpoints to avoid noisy 429 flaps during small waves. Which do we want first?

lee: implement preflight check in rollout controller as hotfix, then adjust circuit-breaker thresholds in a separate PR. I'll start the preflight patch.

release-manager: adding a note to the release changelog: "eu-west-1 regional pin to v3.1.8 due to model-variant mismatch causing embed-synth rate-limited responses during canary (ENG-9502). Rollout continues in other regions; reattempt pending preflight fix."

deploy-bot: Action logged: release-note updated (3311223369).

pat: scheduling reattempt window for 2026-03-25 14:00 UTC; leaving canary global rollout paused until preflight PR merges and we get a clean synthetic run.

lee: FYI I ran a quick sandbox with v3.2.1 + quant-8b and saw 3x memory use vs quant-4b and slower tail latencies. That matches the backoff behavior we observed.

eng-sre: thanks. Please attach the sandbox memory profile to ENG-9502.

ci-bot: note: automated canary gating will block future waves until ENG-9502 is resolved or routing override removed.

release-manager: thanks team. Leaving thread open for ENG-9502 updates. :thumbsup:
